about: The introitus of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: I have risen, and I am still with You, alleluia; You have laid Your hand upon Me, alleluia; Your knowledge has been made wonderful, alleluia, alleluia. O Lord, You have tested Me and known Me; You have known My sitting down and My rising up. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. I have risen, and I am still with You, alleluia; You have laid Your hand upon Me, alleluia; Your knowledge has been made wonderful, alleluia, alleluia.
